messages.author: aaefb6b1a83a78ff
messages.subject: Error: *** inla.core.safe: inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/2
parts:
Hello,

In two days ago, i runned a inla code and it works well, but today does't works. I tried to run the same dataset, in the same computing using R version 4.0.3.

I received the following error:
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Error in if (...length() && any(...names() == "Dimnames")) .Object@Dimnames <- fixupDN(.Object@Dimnames) :
  valor ausente onde TRUE/FALSE necessário

 *** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=1/2
Error in if (...length() && any(...names() == "Dimnames")) .Object@Dimnames <- fixupDN(.Object@Dimnames) :
  valor ausente onde TRUE/FALSE necessário

 *** inla.core.safe:  inla.program has crashed: rerun to get better initial values. try=2/2
Error in if (...length() && any(...names() == "Dimnames")) .Object@Dimnames <- fixupDN(.Object@Dimnames) :
  valor ausente onde TRUE/FALSE necessário
Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  :
  *** Fail to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

What does this mean? How can i solve it ?

Thank you,

Tassinari
